caption: The drawing features a stylized flower positioned slightly to the left of center on an off-white background. The flower has an eight-pointed star-shaped outline for its bloom, consisting of three nested layers: an outermost red outline, a middle white outline, and an innermost dark blue outline. The flower’s stem is a thin, straight yellow line extending downward from the bloom. Two yellow oval-shaped leaves are attached near the upper part of the stem, and two larger, dark blue leaves are attached symmetrically near the base. At the very bottom left corner, there is a partial dark blue leaf, and at the bottom right corner, there are small hints of red and blue forms, only partially visible. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is handwritten text in red ink. The composition is simple and minimally detailed, with all objects and outlines rendered in solid, flat colors without shading.
title: Colcha
